questions.question: Sort a square, a circle, a triangle, a semicircle and a hexagon into straight sides only, curved sides only and both, giving the reason for each.
questions.expected_answer: Straight only: square, triangle and hexagon, because all their sides are straight. Curved only: circle, because its one side is curved. Both: semicircle, because it has one straight side and one curved side.

questions.question: Compare a square and a rectangle, stating what is the same and what is different.
questions.expected_answer: Same: both have four straight sides and four square corners, so both are quadrilaterals. Different: the square has all four sides equal, while the rectangle has only opposite sides equal.

questions.question: Explain how to draw a 5 by 2 rectangle and a right-angled triangle with base 4 and height 3 on grid paper.
questions.expected_answer: Rectangle: start at a grid corner, count 5 squares along a line and mark, count 2 squares up and mark, and join along the grid lines. Triangle: draw the base 4 squares along a grid line, go up 3 squares at one end along a vertical line, and join the top to the far end of the base with a ruler.
